M6235570002N: INDUCTION HEATER:BEARING INDUCTION HEATE INDUCTION HEATER: BEARING INDUCTION HEATER SUITABLE FOR BORE DIAMETER:- ID 20 MM TO 200MM (MAXIMUM OD 400 MM) The offered induction heater shall be capable of heating of bearing weight of equal to or above 100 kg. BEARING INDUCTION HEATER: - 1.INPUT POWER SUPPLY: 200-240V AC/50HZ or 400-430V AC/50 Hz; 2.BORE DIAMETER RANGE:- ID 20 MM to 200MM (MAXIMUM OD 400 MM) 3.STANDARD YOKE SETS: Suitable for the above mentioned bearing sizes. 4.Designed such that it is suitable to handle bearings weight of equal to or above 100 kg. 5.Temperature control should have following features: A) Digital LED display. B) Temperature control from Ambient Temperature to 250°C; in steps of 1°C-2°C and Max Temp. should attainable 4 00°C. C) Temperature control precision of (+/-)2°C. 6.Time control should have following features: A) Digital Display. B)0-60 Minutes in steps of 0.1 Min. 7.Bearing Induction having Auto Cut-Off Function with respect to Set Temperature Point. 8.Over temperature & over current protection should be provided. 9.Heater should have automatic de-magnetization feature. Demagnetization shall be less than 2A/cm. 10.Foldable bearing support arms to safely accommodate and allow larger diameter bearings to be heated and redu cing the risk of the bearing toppling during heating. 11.Vendor will supply one pair of Heat resistant GLOVES, ONE Temperature sensor and three yokes of different siz es. 12.Vendor has to deploy his representative free of cost for initial demo after supply of equipment. 13.The induction heater should be suitable for heating of sealed bearings and pre greased bearings. 14.Vendor will submit detailed technical annexure of the product at the time of offer. 15.Movable Trolley (wheel Mounted) along with supplied induction heater. 16. Risk Purchase :

In the event of Suppliers failure to supply the material of acceptable quality in scheduled delivery perio d, NSPCL reserves the right to procure the materials from any other sources at the supplier’s Risk and Cost and the difference in cost shall be borne by the supplier. Inspection clause: Visual Inspection shall be done at NSPCL Stores, upon receipt of material based on documents submitted by vendor. 2. PBG Clause: Not Applicable 4. Fitment Guarantee: Not Applicable 5. Documents required with Bid for Bid evaluation: Vendors are requested to submit Techno-commercial offer along with endorsed "Nil-Deviation certificate, tender document and SPC". 6. Documents required along with material Supply: 6.1. Guarantee/ warranty certificate. 6.2 Manufacturer Test cum Calibration certificate 6.3 HARD COPY OF USER MANUAL. 7. Drawing and QP Approval: Not Applicable 8. Payment Terms: 100% payment within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of the material at NSPCL Site Stores. 9. Delivery period and Schedule: Delivery to be completed within three months from award. 10. Bid Evaluation Criteria: Total value wise evaluation. 11. Special Instructions: 11.1. Items to quoted strictly, as per Item long text. 11.2. Any deviations in material specifications have to be clarified prior to bid submission, any clarifications post bid opening will not be acceptable. 11.3.Vendor has to provide the detailed list of items/accessories being supplied alongwith the Heater, such as Hand gloves, tool kits, carrying case etc. NOTE:-Bidders are requested to kindly fill the following mandatory information, as applicable, and s ubmit the same along with the offer. a) PLACE OF DESPATCH: b) HSN CODE FOR ALL ITEMS : c) GST RATE FOR ALL ITEMS: .
